## Commitment

The EuroCOMP Lab is committed to making this website accessible, in line with the
principles of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA and the
European standard EN 301 549.

## Current status

::: {.team-note}
**Not yet audited**
The site has been built with accessibility in mind but has not been formally tested. The
status below must be one of "fully compliant", "partially compliant", or "non-compliant",
and that determination requires an audit. Do not publish a claim before testing.
:::

Measures taken during development:

- Semantic heading structure on every page, so screen readers can navigate by section
- Text alternatives on all diagrams, describing what each figure shows
- Diagrams built as scalable vector graphics with real text rather than images of text
- Layouts that reflow on small screens and at increased zoom
- Colour contrast checked against WCAG AA thresholds for body text
